The '''''Scimitar''-class frigate''' was a type of [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]],<ref name="Invincible">''[[Legacy of the Force: Invincible]]''</ref> considered as obsolete by the time of the [[Second Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="Revelation" /> Several were utilized by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Natasi Daala|Daala's]] [[Maw Irregular Fleet]] during the [[Second Battle of Fondor]],<ref name="Revelation" /> and later during the [[Second Battle of Roche]] in [[41 ABY]].<ref name="Invincible" />
